post.instagram_caption:
62% of US stock funds from 20 years ago no longer exist.

S&P Dow Jones Indices' SPIVA U.S. Mid-Year 2026 report followed 2,190 actively managed US stock funds over the 20 years to June 30, 2026. Only 37.85% survived; the rest were merged or liquidated. Over the same 20 years, 94.89% underperformed the S&P Composite 1500 (SPIVA counts funds that disappeared as underperformers). That leaves about 5%, roughly 1 in 20. Past results don't guarantee future ones.

Did you know most funds quietly disappear?

Source: SPIVA U.S. Mid-Year 2026, S&P Dow Jones Indices. Not financial advice.
